description: Call this tool to add files to an existing archive under their own names, or under prefix. A name clash is refused unless replace. An archive holding unsafe entries is refused rather than rewritten.

level.description: Deflate level 0 to 9 for the new entries, default 6

password.description: Not supported. Passing it is refused rather than ignored

paths.description: Files to add, each stored under its own file name. A directory contributes its tree under its own name

prefix.description: Put the new entries under this folder inside the archive, for example "invoices"

replace.description: Replace an entry whose name is already in the archive. Default false: a name clash is refused and nothing is changed

name: zip_add
title: Add files to a zip
